_README: AWS Budgets definition (Terraform-ready shape). Not applied by this project.
AWS Budgets itself is free; the first two budget actions are free, further
actions are billed. See docs/COST_MANAGEMENT.md for the wiring example.

terraform_equivalent.notes: Use limit_unit = "USD", time_unit = "MONTHLY", and cost_filter { name = "TagKeyValue", values = ["user:Project$eawlz"] }.
